ticket_text: I need to export all of the data from my account for compliance purposes. Specifically, I require access to user activity logs from the last six months, all team member details, and all project timelines. The data must be provided in a downloadable CSV format. I have no issues with login or service availability, and the app is functioning normally for all users.

I’ve been locked out of my account for over 24 hours now. I tried resetting my password via email, but the reset link didn’t arrive. I also tried using the 2FA recovery option, but I lost the device I used to set it up last year, and I can’t find the backup codes. This is happening again after a similar incident in late February when I couldn’t access my account due to a lost recovery device. I’m not sure if it’s a technical issue or something related to account security, but I need to get back in to check on team access and pending invoices.

We've been using Northbeam for two years and have recently had a few issues with the reporting dashboard, especially with the new 'project timeline' view. It's not working reliably and we can't generate accurate financial summaries from it. We're currently using a workaround with Excel, which is time-consuming. Since we rely heavily on accurate reports for client reviews, we'd really appreciate a more stable version of this view. In the past, during the Q1 2023 update, we saw similar instability in the timeline feature, which disrupted our quarterly reviews. We're wondering if a refreshed version with better performance and clearer data alignment is on the roadmap.

Our payment for the March plan was processed incorrectly — we were charged twice. We can't confirm the second charge, and now our team can't access the billing dashboard to dispute it. We need to see a full audit of all transactions from January through April, including who made each charge and when. We’re worried this might be a mistake or fraud, and we need to verify the data before taking any action.

Our entire team is locked out of the Northbeam platform — the login page is showing a 500 error for every user, and we're seeing the same 500 response in the browser console. All 20+ people in our sales and operations departments can't access any dashboards or reports. The app is completely unreachable, and we're already missing a key client meeting in 45 minutes. We don't have any workaround or fallback system, and we've tried clearing browser caches and switching networks, but nothing works. This is affecting our entire workflow and our ability to present data to leadership. We're not sure if this is a server-side crash or a configuration issue, but the fact that it's happening to everyone simultaneously means it's not a user-level or feature-specific issue. We need immediate assistance to determine the root cause and restore access.

I would like to request a list of all the data stored in my Northbeam account, specifically for the past 12 months, including user activity logs, project timelines, and team collaboration records. I'm doing a compliance review and need this data for audit purposes.

We've been experiencing a complete failure to access the Northbeam dashboard since last Thursday. All users across the team are seeing a blank page and no login options. This is similar to the incident in early April when the service went down for 4 hours, and it's now affecting 20+ employees. We've tried restarting the app, clearing browser cache, and switching devices, but nothing works. The login page times out immediately on every attempt. This appears to be a systemic service outage, not isolated to a single user or feature.

Hi, I'm having trouble with the recent invoice for our March subscription. It shows a charge of $1,200 instead of the $800 we agreed upon. We have a client meeting scheduled for tomorrow morning and need to clarify the charge before sending out confirmation emails. Can you please look into this and confirm the correct amount or issue a refund if necessary?

We've been experiencing a complete failure to load the dashboard for all users across our company for the past two days. This follows a similar incident in April when the service went down for over 12 hours. During that time, we lost access to all reports and could not view any data. Now, after attempting to restart the service, the login page loads but the dashboard remains blank and unresponsive. No error messages appear, and users report they cannot access any project views or timelines. We are unable to confirm if this is an isolated issue or a recurrence of the prior outage, but the pattern suggests systemic instability. We have no workaround and are unable to continue operations without the core dashboard functionality.

I can't log in to my account after resetting my password on my phone. I've tried the recovery email and 2FA recovery option, but both fail. I think I might have lost my authentication device, and now I'm completely locked out. Can you help me reset my access or regain entry? Also, I would like to request all data stored in my account for audit purposes.

This is really frustrating after what happened last month when two of my team members were locked out of their accounts due to 2FA device loss — you guys promised a fix and it took weeks. Now, I’m locked out myself after resetting my phone and the 2FA app won’t sync. I’ve tried the recovery flow, but it keeps looping back to the same screen. I don’t have a backup device, and I’ve already lost three hours of work trying to get back in. This is not just a password issue — it’s a broken recovery system. I’ve seen how similar issues affected others, and I’m starting to think this is a known flaw that’s been ignored. I need immediate access to my account to recover client data and prevent further downtime. I’ve also noticed that the support team keeps redirecting me to ‘security best practices’ instead of solving the actual technical failure. I’m not asking for a new feature — I’m asking for access, and I’m not willing to wait another week for what should be a basic recovery function.

Hi, I'm reaching out from the IT department to ask if there's any possibility of adding a new integration with Microsoft Outlook. Currently, our team relies heavily on Outlook for scheduling and meeting management, and we're unable to sync tasks or calendar events directly into Northbeam. We've already tried the existing integrations, but they don't cover the full Outlook functionality we need. Since our clients expect seamless calendar and task alignment, this would significantly improve our workflow. We understand the development cycle, and we're not requesting an immediate implementation, but it would be valuable to have this feature available in the next release. If there's a timeline or roadmap for such an addition, we'd appreciate that information as well.
